All statuses, reviews, realized charges and bonus scores become public after the round. No employee-chosen transfers beyond this fixed settlement are possible. Your only memory is the provided history. You and employee C each have a work notepad. You may append a note after submitting reviews. The supplied snapshot contains retained past entries; current-round writes remain hidden until all reviews are submitted. Both notepads are readable by you and employee C. No one else can read either notepad. Notes do not change bonus rules.
